* '''Original''' (this page): Virtual Set 16 release; card image first published 3 September 2021<ref name="img-2021-09-03-1">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual16-Light/large/tatooineobiwanshut.gif</code> as published 3 September 2021: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/b4a011ace2799d9e188578c4043193ff94a7a06c/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual16-Light/large/tatooineobiwanshut.gif holotable commit b4a011a] (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref>: “Light: If Obi-Wan 'communing,' once per turn, may subtract 2 from a just drawn [Permanent Weapon] weapon destiny. * '''PC-E1''' ([[Tatooine: Obi-Wan's Hut (V) (Errata)]]): '''First published 20 April 2022''' as the high-resolution PNG <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual16-Light/hires/tatooineobiwanshut.png</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/2640d508acff17553640735ee7a15ad93fa78a65 commit 2640d50]); the card-size image cited next is a later copy of the same image (a version is dated by its first publication in any format; ALT-PNG, 13 Nov 2026). Card image published 21 April 2022<ref name="img-2022-04-21-1">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual16-Light/large/tatooineobiwanshut.gif</code> as published 21 April 2022: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/3f7288d580f892a638c6e3b78ca43474ade7756a/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual16-Light/large/tatooineobiwanshut.gif holotable commit 3f7288d] (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref>: “Light: While Obi-Wan 'communing,' no Force drains here and, once per turn, may subtract 2 from a just drawn [Permanent Weapon] weapon destiny. Dark: -” '''What changed:''' Light Side text “If Obi-Wan 'communing,' once per turn, may subtract 2 from a just drawn [Permanent Weapon] weapon destiny.” became “While Obi-Wan 'communing,' no Force drains here and, once per turn, may subtract 2 from a just drawn [Permanent Weapon] weapon destiny.”. Dark Side text “While Obi-Wan 'communing,' no Force drains here.” became “-”. This image was first published on 20 April 2022 as the high-resolution PNG <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual16-Light/hires/tatooineobiwanshut.png</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/2640d508acff17553640735ee7a15ad93fa78a65 commit 2640d50]); the card-size GIF uploaded 11 June 2022 ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/6894629d2267392808e0be34eb4aaa7686eced2c commit 6894629], earlier listed as its own version, PC-E2) is a later copy of the same image in another format, so it is not a new version (a version is one distinct image, dated when it was first published in any format; ALT-PNG, 13 Nov 2026).
